paragraphs.text:
Finally, the fight is over. You go out to check the bodies and 
find them to be pink, fungoid crustaceans of great size. From the 
way they fought, they must have been intelligent indeed. Your 
scientific excitement rises. What specimens they will make!

Unfortunately, a strange deterioration sets into the bodies. 
By midday, there is nothing left of them but slime.
